title: Glovebox Field Tote
care: Keep a notebook, a folded layer and the small things for a road-day stop together. An open top makes them easy to reach; put wet or leaky items in a separate bag.
Spot clean the canvas and allow it to dry fully before folding it away. Store it somewhere dry between trips.
The dimensions describe this illustrated design, not a measured sample. No carrying-load rating has been tested. The tote is not waterproof and is not a dry bag.
